Dead shells, liquidations and worthless equity are excluded automatically from the DCF's own verdict; state/never_interested.txt adds names by hand (one TICKER  reason per line). These rows never enter the ranking.

STALE: DCF or Analysis older than the staleness threshold · PRICE_DRIFT: live price far from the price the DCF was built on — stored upside unreliable · NO_PRICE: no usable price, live or stored · NO_IV: DCF has no probability-weighted intrinsic value · NO_DCF: tracked company without a DCF model yet · SANITY_FAIL: the DCF's own sanity check tripped — its implied multiples sit outside the ticker's 10-year history; hover the badge for the reasons · CCY: the intrinsic value is denominated in a different currency from the live quote — upside mixes currencies · Eval: tier-1 scorecard pass rate (F fails / W warns), from state/scores/. · Upside @15%: the base case rebuilt at a 15% required return (each DCF's own required-return table) against the same price — a discount-rate stress, not the verdict; the rank never uses it.
